legend.action: REUSE = exists, wrap it | EVOLVE = exists, extend backward-compatibly | BUILD = genuinely absent | DECISION = blocked on a founder answer | OUT_OF_SCOPE_V1 = documented, deferred
legend.verification: VERIFIED = read directly in C0 with file:line | UNVERIFIED = inventory-agent evidence only, the adversarial refute pass did not run

gaps.requirement: FounderPermit entity + authority (objective-scoped, hash-bound, revocable, with ceilings)
gaps.existing: Approval (single-subject, single-use) + founderOSCommand preview->confirm
gaps.notes: Must extend the existing hash-binding pattern, not replace Approval. Wire into campaignPreflight.ts:203 so the dimension stops being UNKNOWN.

gaps.requirement: CommandReceipt ledger with hash chain
gaps.existing: No generic receipt entity; receipts are opaque string refs inside other rows
gaps.notes: Domain receipts stay canonical proof; CommandReceipt aggregates traceability only (spec 3.5).

gaps.requirement: Durable Conversation + CommandRun
gaps.existing: sessionStorage string; AgentTask carries the real lifecycle
gaps.action: BUILD (Conversation) + REUSE (AgentTask as the unit of work)
gaps.notes: CommandRun coordinates; it must not become a second task plane.

gaps.requirement: New entities registered for retention and RLS
gaps.existing: Voluntary registration, free-text entity linkage
gaps.notes: Register every new Command entity deliberately; nothing enforces it.

gaps.requirement: CAMBRA Command page + conversation sidebar, branches, context inspector
gaps.existing: AdminChat (Ask CAMBRA), AdminCommand (Founder OS), AdminCopilot (legacy)
gaps.notes: Legacy pages stay until parity, same rule applied in Campaigns C9.

gaps.requirement: Truth Context Builder + assertion manifest with epistemic states
gaps.existing: runtimeSourceRead, researchKnowledge, IntelligenceEvidence, KnowledgeClaim
gaps.notes: The knowledge/evidence domain was NOT inventoried in C0 (session limit). Inventory it before opening C3.

gaps.requirement: Multi-turn tool loop — model must see tool output and decide the next step
gaps.existing: Single model call per request; tool output never returned to the model
gaps.notes: This is the single biggest functional gap. Without it Command cannot do multi-step work at all.

gaps.requirement: Generated tool registry + just-in-time tool search
gaps.existing: 48 tools hardcoded inline in CHAT_TOOLS
gaps.notes: Generate the registry; keep the existing 4-gate execution path as the enforcement spine.

gaps.requirement: Standard Tool Result Envelope
gaps.existing: Ad-hoc per-tool shapes

gaps.requirement: Tenant scope on every tool call
gaps.existing: brand_id injected only in the forced-draft branch; dropped for all 31 L1 tools
gaps.notes: Safety-relevant: a Command surface with broader reach must not inherit this.

gaps.requirement: Bulk-confirmation coverage across the whole tool surface
gaps.existing: Declared on 4 of 48 tools

gaps.requirement: Provider-neutral model router
gaps.existing: Anthropic hardcoded at several layers; only OpenAI code is in a FROZEN file
gaps.notes: Founder decision 3. A second provider implies new credentials, new cost surface and a freeze update.

gaps.requirement: Per-model/per-token cost reservation and settlement
gaps.existing: Flat per-category constant; AI spend never settled to a real amount
gaps.notes: Command makes this material: it will be the largest LLM spender.

gaps.requirement: Emergency stop must pause AI spend
gaps.existing: Category 'ai' maps to no emergency capability
gaps.notes: CRITICAL. Closing this is a precondition for Command running anything autonomously, not a C5 nicety.

gaps.requirement: Founder Executor Node + Remote MCP
gaps.existing: Nothing; no personal-account auth anywhere
gaps.notes: Founder decision 1. Highest security surface in the plan; spec forbids opening it without explicit confirmation.

gaps.requirement: Python/SQL analysis sandbox
gaps.existing: No sandbox, container or execution environment of any kind
gaps.notes: Greenfield. Consider whether v1 needs it at all.

gaps.requirement: Web research with source snapshot and citations
gaps.existing: researchKnowledge + publicHttpEgress (opt-in per call site, not a chokepoint)

gaps.requirement: Real engineering flow: diffs, atomic multi-file commits, CI trigger, test execution
gaps.existing: developerMigrationEngine does whole-file LLM replacement, one commit per file, CI polled by a UI button, tests generated then discarded
gaps.notes: Also: no repository allowlist and no self-modification guard — the engine can currently be pointed at CAMBRA's own repo.

gaps.requirement: Browser/computer use
gaps.existing: Nothing

gaps.requirement: Command runtime hosted without growing the physical function quota
gaps.existing: 276 physical / 29 logical; adding a logical route requires topology + BASE44_LOGICAL_ROUTE_TARGET + 2 invariant tests together
